robot.representation: official URDF forward kinematics + official collision meshes; frozen scene geometry
robot.gripper: not installed; URDF exposes left/right end links

cart.capacity_policy: stop belt when receiving tray occupied; no automatic accumulation yet

limitations: Scene preparation only; no grasp policy or harness
G2 collision geometry is frozen; import source URDF with validated end effector for articulated dynamics
Mailers use rigid convex collision, not deformable cloth
Conveyor is static; nominal speed is metadata until harness drive is attached
Object contents are semantic payloads; mass is lumped into each parcel
Contact parameters and dimensions of packaging are scenario assumptions, not calibrated measurements
